annotations.title: Real-Time News Recency, Trending Story Clusters & Velocity Tracker

description: Tracks breaking news feeds, clusters trending story cycles, and calculates story publication velocity over recent timeframes. Use when analyzing breaking market catalysts, emerging controversies, or ongoing product announcements; for evaluating sentiment polarity across media, use analyze_media_sentiment instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'topic' ('recency_window' defaults to 'past_24_hours'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

recency_window.description: News timestamp search window: past hour, past 24 hours, past 7 days, or past 30 days.

sentiment_cluster.description: Whether to calculate sentiment direction across news story clusters.

topic.description: Subject, ticker symbol, brand, or public event to scan for breaking news developments.

name: analyze_news_recency

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for analyze_news_recency.

story_clusters.description: Deduplicated clusters of related news coverage with source attribution.

temporal_velocity.description: Rate of new article publication (e.g., accelerating, steady, tapering).

top_headlines.description: List of most prominent headline items with timestamps and publishers.

topic.description: Monitored news topic or subject entity.

title: Real-Time News Recency, Trending Story Clusters & Velocity Tracker
